# phase-space Euclidean

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:metricSymplectic`](gmeow-metricSymplectic.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/metricSymplectic>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Standard Euclidean distance metric on a finite-dimensional Hamiltonian phase space, treating the concatenated (q,p) state vector as a point in ℝ²ⁿ.
